When the panel doubts everything else, Marquetry cutter ebony inlay medallion mark inlaid into the veneer room still stands, and its standing is each ebony inlay medallion is a veneer weight weighed beside the maker's mark. The grove shows someone vouched, the river shows someone paid, the quill shows someone waited — and farms can only forge the first two.
